name: Universal Championship
epitaph: The fed's top title, with two holders on its two held home pages: Blair Kivisto in about March 2009, who had just held it against Gage Gannon at Numbered Days, and Tyler Havoc in about January 2010. The January 2010 page says Andy Titsuhiro has held it twice and Ricky Stanton three times; no date of any of those reigns survives.

name: Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: The fed's second singles title, held by Bucky Skyler on its about March 2009 home page and by Tyrone Kidd on its about January 2010 page.

name: Prime Time Championship
epitaph: A singles title the fed calls the Prime Time Championship, held by Edward Stiles on its about March 2009 home page and by Zoey Swan on its about January 2010 page.

name: Hardcore Championship
epitaph: The fed's Hardcore Championship, held by Ravi Moon on its about January 2010 home page; the about March 2009 page prints the words 'Held Up' where a champion's name would go.

name: Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's tag titles, held by the Horsemen on its about March 2009 home page and by Serena and Darren Revel on its about January 2010 page.
